purpose: S0038 finding 2. The hosted demo's database, and with it the runtime budget ledger, is temporary: every restart or new revision starts empty. The runtime caps are therefore only a per-instance brake. The limit that actually bounds spend across restarts must be set at each provider for the exact key the cloud uses. deploy/service.live.yaml must not be deployed until every item below is CONFIRMED with evidence.

items.evidence: Owner's statement in the working session on 2026-10-15 ("all done"). No console screenshot or key-limit text was shown to the engineer; Astra may ask for it before sealing.

items.what: The Secret Manager secrets hold only the keys covered above (not the spare or the free-tier key), and the service account's Secret Accessor role is set on exactly those secrets.
